title: research-session provider adapter input (v1)
description: Keys accepted by audit_dispatch._provider_config. api_key_env names an environment variable only; it never contains a secret value.

url.description: Explicit http(s) Responses endpoint ending in /responses, without credentials, query or fragment.

model.description: Wire model requested for review; no implicit default.

provider.description: Provider label recorded in the route binding; defaults to responses when omitted.

api_key_env.description: Name of the environment variable holding the credential; never the credential itself.
